id: title:Gilbert09:skip billing check instead of crashing when the job is missing

review.posthog_relevance: Adds defensive handling for missing billing jobs in warehouse ingestion, preventing workflow failure when a billing record is absent, and includes a regression test.
review.reason: The change adds a try/except block around an external dependency lookup (`ExternalDataJob.objects.get`) to return False instead of raising an exception, and includes a corresponding test. This represents a localized, bounded improvement in reliability and workflow continuity for warehouse ingestion, without broader systemic changes or unverified benefit claims.
review.uncertainty: The actual production benefit and adoption are not established; this is a defensive implementation without evidence of prior failures or measured improvement.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned. No adoption, incident, or benefit inferred. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a try/except around ExternalDataJob.objects.get to handle missing jobs; returns False instead of raising DoesNotExist.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks billing limits before warehouse ingestion; if the billing job is missing, the workflow skips billing rather than failing.

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting the activity returns False when the referenced job does not exist, using a UUID that does not resolve to a real job.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection for the missing-job handling; does not establish production behavior or benefit.
